The script checks 16x16 incidence valencies, all 96 flags, all powers as exact orbit lengths, and CSV table; this finite exhaustive check is not extrapolation from field samples.

value.rationale: The finite étale 96-edge Kummer incidence scheme is an intrinsic, mathematically motivated refinement of the classical 16-node and 16-trope schemes. Each separate scheme has 9 Frobenius spectra for 11 branch partitions, with two permanent ambiguity pairs despite any extension data, whereas only three rational incidence-pair counts distinguish all 11. The cutoff is optimal in all odd finite fields. This sharp uniform reconstruction of branch-degree arithmetic, and the exact 11-case incidence zeta table, supply an informative intrinsic invariant rather than an arbitrary number table; no curve-isomorphism reconstruction or downstream theorem is claimed.
